headline: Executive order sets up a performance-based organization to run air traffic control services within the federal government.
what_it_does: Based on its title, this order creates or directs the creation of a 'performance-based organization' for air traffic services. This is a government unit that is managed around measurable goals and results. No summary was provided, so the exact structure, powers, and goals are not described here.

who_it_affects.group: Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) employees who work in air traffic control
who_it_affects.how: Their work would likely be organized under a new unit managed around performance goals.
They rely on the air traffic services this new organization would provide.

when_it_takes_effect: Likely upon signing on December 7, 2000; no other date was provided.
